transcript.text: Alright everyone, thanks for being here. As we kick off this pre-show approval meeting, I want to go around the room and hear from each of you — technical, legal, insurance, and talent leads — on any operational requirements or concerns you have before I issue the final plan and theater operating instructions for the September 14 recording at the Orpheum. Let's start with technical.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical issue before we finalize the plan. During this week's load test at the Orpheum, I measured the loading-dock lift and it has a hard 900-kilogram limit. The rotating scenic unit in the current draft plan weighs 1,100 kilograms, which exceeds that limit by 200 kilograms. The good news is that splitting it into two 550-kilogram modules is workable and would get us under the limit. However, I have not yet updated the load-in drawing to reflect this change, so we'll need to account for that before final approval.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a rights clearance issue. I confirmed with the archive licensor yesterday that the special's historical comedy clips are cleared for the theater recording and domestic broadcast, but they are NOT cleared for online replay. The current draft plan includes an online replay, so we have a problem. I also want to note that I have not yet entered this restriction in the distribution worksheet, so it's not reflected there yet.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I have an insurance requirement that needs to be addressed before final approval. I obtained the insurer's written event endorsement this morning, and it requires that the audience be seated in three blocks separated by two unobstructed aisles, each at least 1.2 meters wide, for coverage to remain valid. The current draft plan seats the audience in two blocks, which does not meet this requirement. I should also note that the endorsement is currently still attached to my email rather than the production file, so it hasn't been formally filed yet.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to flag a talent-related issue before we finalize the plan. I confirmed with the comedian's representative this week that the comedian's approved participation permits moderated questions submitted before the show, but does NOT permit unscripted audience questions. The current draft plan includes live audience questions, which conflicts with this restriction. I should also note that I have not yet added this format restriction to the talent call sheet, so it's not reflected there.
transcript.speaker: A5
